Method of Attack: Phishing attacks delivering remote access tools (RAT) to enable corporate data theft
Use of commercially available remote desktop solutions for unauthorized access
Installation of multiple RATs for redundancy and persistence
Use of network scanning and file sharing tools for reconnaissance, pivoting, and data theft
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with fake subscription renewal notices and fake invoices
Impacted Systems: Corporate systems targeted via phishing campaigns
Indicators of Compromise: Emails impersonating Zoho, MasterClass, Duolingo brands sent from Gmail accounts
Fake invoices with contact phone numbers leading to scammer instructions
Use of close to 90 domain names resembling impersonated brands for phishing and data exfiltration
